title: For real: Jets pick Sadiq feared draft call was hoax

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: For real: Jets pick Sadiq feared draft call was hoax
sources.description: For a second, Jets first-round draft pick Kenyon Sadiq thought his "Welcome to the NFL" moment was a hoax. His mind flashed to last year's draft and Shedeur Sanders. The viral moment occurred when the tight end from Oregon was selected 16th overall.
